source_clause: EDPR8.2) If a Profile not linked to a memory seat is deleted, “User 1” or the last known Profile, prior to the deleted one, will become active.
leaf_desc_037: EDPR8.2) If a Profile not linked to a memory seat is deleted, “User 1” or the last known Profile, prior to the deleted one, will become active.
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.7.2（EDPR8.2）—— 刪除未連結記憶座椅之 profile 後，「User 1」或前一個已知 profile 成為現用。關鍵情境條件：pre-condition 明訂被刪者未連結座椅 ——已連結者之行為條文未述，不在本 TC。為什麼這樣切：條文以「或」給出兩個可接受結果，ER 照錄其二擇一，不自行選定其一（§8.4.1）。

tcs.tc_title: User 1 or the last known Profile becomes active after deletion
tcs.test_item:
User 1 or the last known Profile becomes active after deletion

(Verifies that User 1 or the last known Profile becomes active after an unlinked Profile is deleted)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Three Driver Profiles exist and Profile A is active
2. Profile A is not linked to any memory seat
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record which Profile was active before Profile A
2. Delete Profile A and confirm the deletion
3. Read the Profile List and check which Profile is active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Profile active before Profile A is recorded
2. Profile A is deleted
3. “User 1” or the Profile recorded in step 1 is active
tcs.priority_basis: 刪除後之 active profile 接續；失效即無現用 profile
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
